text:
iona_cs: Quick check-in for Sable's private cutover — a few open items on network/IAM/KMS/logs before we flip traffic. TL;DR: need firewall egress, a short-lived SA for log export, KMS grants, and audit retention confirmation.
kevin_netops: I can confirm egress to the collector IP is blocked currently. I'll open the rule but need the exact port/protocol.
iona_cs: Collector is 10.2.4.5:514/udp. Also they'll want TCP 6514 for TLS syslog as a fallback.
kevin_netops: Ack. Planned rule: allow from Sable VPC CIDR 10.18.0.0/16 -> 10.2.4.5 ports 514/udp,6514/tcp. I'll PR the terraform in infra-repo today.
maya_sre: For the service account, recommend creating a short-lived SA scoped to logging export with roles/logging.logWriter and kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the specific key only. No org-wide roles.
liam_eng: FYI, their infra team asked if we can use an externally-managed KMS key (they hold key in their account). We support external key grants — we just need the key ARN and a policy snippet.
emily_cs: Sable mentioned audit retention: 1 year minimum for compliance. Can we confirm audit logs will be stored 365 days and accessible for e-discovery?
onboarding-bot: Reminder: playbook step 6.3 pending — "Enable audit export to S3/GCS and set lifecycle 365d". Assigned to: emily_cs. Due: 2169876600.
liam_eng: Quick snippet for granting our runtime SA access to their KMS key (AWS example):
```
{
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDFWOOD_RUNTIME_ACCOUNT:role/redwood-runner"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01"
    }
  ]
}
```
kevin_netops: One gotcha: their NGFW performs DPI and will rewrite some packets; confirm syslog TLS so we don't lose events.
iona_cs: Good catch. Sable ops to enable TLS syslog on the collector (6514) and we'll keep UDP 514 as backup for initial ramp.
emily_cs: Renewal risk note: customer success flagged that cutover delays past next Tuesday increase renewal conversation friction. If infra or KMS policy stalls, mark as at-risk.
jenna_sales: @emily_cs noted. Can we schedule a focused enablement call with Sable security and our infra experts tomorrow 10am PT? I can invite.
maya_sre: I'm available. Agenda: firewall PR review, SA creation pattern, KMS grant template, audit export validation, and rollback plan. 30-45m should do.
iona_cs: Action items: kevin — open terraform PR for egress rule (due EOD today). liam — share KMS policy examples and confirm ARN format (due EOD). emily — confirm audit export retention and verify on their bucket/GCS lifecycle (due before enablement call). jenna — send invite for 10am PT. I'll draft an enablement checklist to capture feedback during the call.
kevin_netops: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-498 — please review.
liam_eng: KMS examples posted to the thread and drive link: https://drive.redwood/sable-kms-snippets
emily_cs: I verified retention policy with Sable ops — they will set 395 days to be safe. Confirmed.
jenna_sales: Invite sent to Sable-sec + redwood infra + cs + sales. Calendar link in the thread.
iona_cs: Great progress. After the call I'll capture feedback items for docs (esp. the KMS cross-account snippet and a quick-playbook for fallback logs). Please react with :thumbsup: when you've completed your action.
